notes.title: MikoVerse Early Alpha Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Everyone![/b][/h1]

The [b]MikoVerse Early Alpha[/b] is now available for everyone! Get access by requesting access on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914710/MikoVerse/][b]store page[/b][/url], then head over to your game library to find it, [b]download[/b] and [b]play![/b] 💫

For any questions or feedback, feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/mikoverse][b]Discord![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/f0ff4deb126bd3a4760fd3fde84d164dee25ae0c.png[/img]

[h2]The AI Companion Creator[/h2]

The AI Companion Creator is an [b]extra feature[/b] which allows you to create an AI character by importing your own VRM model or selecting from the default character screen. You’ll be able to write custom prompts to design unique character personalities, resulting in NPC-like companions with rich, personal interactions to keep you company in the MikoVerse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/6ec97217164da8800c746aa33a02d8720422170d.png[/img]

The AI Companion Creator lets you bring your companion to life in multiplayer or private servers, creating a dynamic world filled with vibrant NPCs. This opens up new storytelling possibilities, allowing you to share unique experiences with other players. You can direct your AI companions to follow you and interact in a variety of ways, expanding your gameplay in ways never before possible. Whether you're live streaming, creating YouTube content, making TikToks, or just enjoying it for personal use, the AI Companion Creator offers endless opportunities to craft engaging, fun experiences.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914710/MikoVerse/][img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOTMzMzVsbXQ2eXFvOTV6em9kbTI2MG94ZTM5amlsa2ttamN3ZzZkZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/omkj2fbt6F8IpHS8hy/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

The AI Companion Creator operates on a subscription model, where $23 per month grants you 1,000 interactions. Keep in mind, this feature is in its early stages, and we’ll continue to improve and expand it over time.

[b]You don't need the AI Companion Creator to enjoy MikoVerse multiplayer[/b] and it isn't an AI art generator; you'll need to use your own models or those available as default in MikoVerse.

- [i]The MikoVerse Team[/i]
